# BLUEBOOK - Philippine Christian University

> PCU BLUEBOOK is the comprehensive learning platform and university portal for student enrollment and interactive online classes.

BLUEBOOK serves as the central hub for Philippine Christian University students to manage their academic enrollment and participate in interactive virtual learning environments. The platform is designed to support modern distance and hybrid learning through a web-based interface.
